purpose: Reject weak hourly spot hypotheses before order-book and forward validation
selection: Discovery gate then highest worst-cost return, deterministic strategy-name tie break; validation must pass unchanged; only then inspect held-out period
capital_note: 100 USDT is a synthetic reference, not a conversion of personal capital. Allocation is a research assumption, not approved live risk.
fee_note: Current-cost counterfactual using public base USDT taker rate observed 2026-11-14; not a historical schedule or account-verified tier. Buy fees in received base, sell fees in quote. Stress doubles the fee.
limitations: Current asset choices create selection bias. No liquidation, leverage, tax, FX/IRT attribution or point-in-time historical fees. Hourly proxy fills need independent calibration. This screen cannot authorize deployment.
prior_observation: BTC discovery outcomes from baseline-v1b are already seen; ETH/SOL performance and all validation/held-out performance remain uninspected at registration.
